verdict.rationale: Brex is a SaaS financial platform with a developer API, so an official CLI is a fair thing to ask about. The evidence pack documents REST APIs, webhooks, an MCP server, Postman and Pipedream/Zapier integrations, but nothing describes an official command-line tool. Those adjacent tools earn no credit toward a CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
